eventMetadata.context_description: Utah State's edge in recent form drives their 55.5% implied probability as slight favorites over Villanova, with the Aggies winning four of their last five games amid a hot Mountain West finish, while the Wildcats dropped three straight entering the matchup. Official injury reports show Villanova without starting forward Eric Dixon (knee, out indefinitely), weakening their frontcourt against Utah State's physical big man Great Osobor, who averages 17.7 points and 9.0 rebounds. Matchup dynamics favor the Aggies' up-tempo style (78.2 possessions per game) over Villanova's slower Big East pace, especially with Utah State holding home-court rest advantage in this NIT second-round clash; traders reflect this consensus shift from even odds a week ago.
